bosses.name: Mano
bosses.where: Thicket Around the Beach III (Victoria Road, near Lith Harbor)
bosses.tryAt: Lv 20+ solo, or a duo at 15+
bosses.tip: Everyone's first boss. It barely moves, so ranged classes can kite it along the floor. Its touch still hits 280 to 380, so carry potions if you're under 25.

bosses.name: King Slime
bosses.where: Kerning City Party Quest, last stage
bosses.tip: Resists every element, so physical attackers do the heavy lifting. It slams the ground: jump just before it lands and the shockwave passes under you. Full run in the KPQ guide.

bosses.name: Mushmom
bosses.where: Someone Else's House (hidden street, Henesys area)
bosses.tryAt: Lv 40+ with a stack of potions, or a party at 35
bosses.tip: The money boss. Players report Ilbi Throwing-Stars dropping, which every Thief wants. Fire Wizards hit its weakness. Killing it is also a step in Maya's lv 47 citizenship chain.

bosses.name: Shade
bosses.where: Cabin of the Forsaken (hidden map off the Murky Swamp, Kerning City)
bosses.tip: Not a meso farm, but the lv 47 citizenship chain A Grudge That Won't Rest (Chun Ji) has you kill 50 Wraiths and then Shade, for about 50,000 EXP.

bosses.name: Zombie Mushmom
bosses.where: The Grave of Mushmom (dungeon past the Ant Tunnel)
bosses.tip: Touch damage runs 770 to 1,045, so bring HP potions and a party. It's holy-weak, so a Cleric pulls their weight here. Another source of Ilbis.

bosses.name: Rotten Mushmom
bosses.where: Someone Else's Grave (Forgotten Hollow, off Decayed Tunnel I)
bosses.tip: A brand-new boss made for Classic, living in the Forgotten Hollow zone that opens on Nov 18. Weak to both holy and fire, and poison barely tickles it.

bosses.name: Jr. Balrog
bosses.where: The Cursed Sanctuary (past Sanctuary Entrance IV, Sleepywood)
bosses.tryAt: A strong party at 70+ with the accuracy to hit it
bosses.maybe: Old pre-Big Bang drop tables also list 60% weapon attack scrolls and level 60 to 70 weapons. Not confirmed in Classic yet.
bosses.tip: The final boss of Victoria Island. You need about 157 accuracy at level 80 (219 at level 70) to hit it reliably. Mystic Door and Teleport Rock don't work in its room, so walk in stocked up.

bossFaq: Which bosses are in MapleStory Classic at launch?

The Grand Launch notes list six field bosses: Mano, Stumpy, Mushmom, Shade, Zombie Mushmom and Jr. Balrog. Stumpy is new at launch; we'll add its card once its level and spawn are confirmed. King Slime is the KPQ boss, and Rotten Mushmom arrives with Forgotten Hollow on Nov 18.
What is the easiest boss in MapleStory Classic?
Mano, the giant snail near Lith Harbor. It's level 20, moves slowly and stays on its floor, so most classes can solo it around level 20.
How long is the boss respawn timer?
Most bosses store a 1-hour timer in the map data, but players report closer to 90 minutes, so plan for 1 to 1.5 hours. Jr. Balrog is about 3 hours. King Slime only appears inside KPQ.
Players have reported Ilbis from Mushmom and Zombie Mushmom. They're one of the most valuable drops for Thieves.
Is Crimson Balrog in MapleStory Classic?
Not at launch. It attacks the boat to Orbis, and Ossyria isn't in Classic yet.
What level should I fight Jr. Balrog?
It's level 80 with 325,400 HP and needs about 157 accuracy at level 80. Bring a strong party at 70 or above, and check your accuracy first.

kpq.start: Form a party of 4, then the leader talks to Lakelis by the sewer entrance in Kerning City. Grab the one-time quest Proof of Companionship from Lakelis first: killing King Slime once pays 1,870 EXP, 687 mesos, 1 fame and a random 60% earring stat scroll.

stages.title: Coupons for Cloto
stages.text: 22 Ligators (68 EXP each) drop coupons. Cloto asks every member except the leader a question, and each answers by handing over that many coupons for a Pass. Drop extra coupons; only the exact number counts.
stages.tip: If someone draws the 35-coupon question, make them the leader: the leader never gets asked, and the old leader draws a fresh, probably cheaper question.

stages.title: The ropes
stages.text: Four ropes: A and B on the high branch, C and D on the low ones. Three members hang on three ropes, the leader checks with Cloto, and you work through the 4 possible combinations.

stages.title: The kittens
stages.text: Five platforms carrying 1 to 5 kittens. Three members stand on three of them. There are 10 combinations, and the commonly shared list forgets 3‑4‑5.

stages.title: The barrels
stages.text: Six numbered barrels stacked 1, 2-3, 4-5-6. Three members stand on three of them. 20 combinations, so split up who calls them out.

stages.title: King Slime
stages.text: Curse Eyes up top, Jr. Neckis in the middle, King Slime at the bottom. All ten drop a coupon, and the leader hands all ten to Cloto. Jr. Neckis dodge a lot, so bring at least one player with good accuracy.
stages.tip: King Slime resists every element and splits into 11 Slimes. Jump just before it lands to dodge the ground slam.

stages.title: Bonus room
stages.text: 36 Horny and Green Mushrooms in one tiny map, the densest in the quest. Clear it, then talk to Nella to leave. She stands on every KPQ map.

cloto: DEX a Bowman or Thief needs
kpq.clotoNote: Questions can change; these are the ones players have seen so far. Hand over the exact number and drop the spares.
kpq.expNote: Players report about half a level per run at Lv 21-22 and 30-40% of a level at Lv 25, in about 35 minutes with the bonus room.
kpq.shoes: Level 28, any class, +1 to all four stats, 18 weapon defense, 7 magic defense, 5 upgrade slots, tradeable.
rules: Party chat: type J>PQ with your level and class to join, or L>PQ / R>PQ if you're building one.
Done with your coupons? Help whoever is slowest.
Say so before you go AFK, and don't leave or kick mid-run.
Explain the combos calmly to first-timers. You were one once.
kpq.death: Dying no longer ends the run. Three players can still finish: stage 1 needs two passes instead of three, and the leader fills the empty spot on the puzzles. Drop to two before the puzzles are done and you'll need to rebuild.
other: Limited event, mid-November to early December 2026.
Arrives Dec 9, 2026. Details not published yet.
Not in Classic at launch: their regions aren't live.
faq: What level do you need for KPQ in MapleStory Classic?
Level 21, with no upper cap. The original game capped it at 30.
Can you solo KPQ?
No. You need a party of exactly 4 to enter, though 3 can finish if someone drops mid-run.
What are Cloto's coupon answers?

10 for a job advancement level, 15 for the EXP from level 1 to 2, 20 for a Magician's INT, 21 for the KPQ entry level, 25 for a Bowman or Thief's DEX, 30 for the 2nd job level, and 35 for a Warrior's STR.
What does King Slime drop?
Squishy Shoes (level 28, +1 all stats, 5 slots) and a Pass. Everyone also gets a Companion's Magic Box at the end.
Which channels is KPQ on?
Channels 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7.

events.name: The Journey Begins
events.text: A daily gift from the Maple Administrator, once a day per account, 14 gifts in all. Together they add up to 30 Red and 70 Blue Potions, 40 Cakes, 6 Safety Charms, 6 Megaphones, 2 Regular Store Permits and a Snail pet.

events.name: Housing
events.text: Reach the Visitor grade, then buy a home with mesos from Bianca (Henesys) or Scarlett (Kerning City). One home per account, shared by all your characters. Decorate it and visit friends. The price isn't published yet.

events.name: Mark of the Beta
events.text: A treasure-trail quest chain that starts with Jay in Henesys. Played a closed test? Nexon mails you the Classic Beginnings Label and Chat Rings: one of each per test you finished.

events.name: Excavation Site and Stumpy
events.text: A new Perion area with 8 monsters (Ghost Stumps, masks, skeledogs and skeleton soldiers) and Stumpy, the sixth field boss. Nexon hasn't listed the levels or Stumpy's spawn yet.

events.name: Halloween
events.text: Bring Malady 100 Halloween Candies for the Pumpkin Basket, a one-handed sword with +27 attack. Orange Slimes invade Henesys, Ellinia, Kerning City and Perion and drop candy and healing Malady's Candy too.

events.name: GM events
events.text: Short GM-hosted games from 00:00 to 02:00 UTC (the evening before in the US): a jump quest, Coconut Harvest and Up and Up. Win a Scroll of Secrets and trade it for a random Magic Box prize. One game per 24 hours.

events.name: Forgotten Hollow
events.text: The first new zone, entered from the Tree Dungeon near Ellinia or from deep in Sleepywood. Brings Rotten Mushmom, new Citizenship story, and Manji and Dark Lord quests.

events.name: Moon Bunny's Rice Cake
events.text: A Thanksgiving event party quest. It's temporary, so run it while it's here.

events.name: Guilds, Hollow PQ and Happyville
events.text: Guilds arrive (made in Lith Harbor; guild houses come later), plus a new Forgotten Hollow party quest and the Happyville Christmas town.

patches.title: Launch build vs the closed test
items: Slash Blast, Rush, Iron Arrow, Arrow Bomb and Poison Breath now hit 6 monsters (were 4). Only 3rd-job AoEs were cut to 4.
Holy Arrow became one big single-target hit. Final Attack procs 25% of the time (was 50%) and now costs MP.
Bless now cuts party damage taken by 15% instead of giving accuracy and avoid.
Weapon attack scrolls got stronger: Greater +4 and Chaos +5 (were +3 and +4). Lesser weapon scrolls cost 30,000 mesos at NPCs.
62 monsters were retuned: 40 give less EXP and 39 are harder to hit. King Slime's EXP went from 248 to 2,400.
246 quests had their EXP changed, mostly up. The Deep Forest of Patience quests now need Lv 65.

faq: When does MapleStory Classic World launch?
Grand Launch is Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 11:00 AM PDT, after maintenance from 6:00 AM PDT. It's free to play.
Does Founder's Access progress carry over?
Yes. Founder's Access characters, items and levels carry into Grand Launch with no wipe.
What events are on at launch?
The Journey Begins daily gift and Mark of the Beta run Oct 21 to Nov 18. Halloween starts Oct 27 at 5 PM PDT (Oct 28, 00:00 UTC), and Moon Bunny's Rice Cake runs from mid-November.
Can new accounts trade in MapleStory Classic?
Not right away. Trading unlocks 24 hours after any character on the account reaches level 15.
Is Stumpy in MapleStory Classic?
Yes. Grand Launch added Stumpy as the sixth field boss, along with the Excavation Site in Perion. Nexon hasn't listed its level or spawn yet.
When do guilds come to MapleStory Classic?
December 9, 2026. Guilds are created in Lith Harbor.
Is there a level cap on gear?
Yes, for now obtainable equipment stops at level 50. Nexon says it will rise in later updates.
When is 3rd job coming?
There's no date. Nexon plans a 3rd job test server in early 2027.

questFaq: What are the best quests in MapleStory Classic?

For EXP: Maya and the Weird Medicine (21), Caretaker's Ledger (28), Mr. Wetbottom's Secret Book (32), Ronnie's fairy house chain (41) and John's Present (65), plus the citizenship donation chains from level 12. For mesos: Special Taste of Florina Beach and What Shumi Lost.
Every Maple Island quest. The boat to Lith Harbor is one-way, so hand them all in before you leave.
Are quests worth it in Classic?
Yes. Many give more than a full level at the level you can start them, plus potions you'd otherwise buy.
When can I join a citizenship?
Level 12, in Henesys or Kerning City. The donation chains reward common drops you'd normally vendor.

faq: What is the best way to make mesos early in MapleStory Classic?
Sell ores, Leather and fur to crafters on the Free Market, vendor duplicate early weapons, and do the meso-heavy quests: What Shumi Lost and Special Taste of Florina Beach.
What sells best on the Free Market?
In launch week: Iron Ore, Bronze Ore, Leather, Mithril Ore, Selective 5-slot Coupons, Weighted Earrings and 60% attack scrolls.
Which boss drops the most mesos?
Of the reported bosses, Mushmom: about 1,800 to 2,200 mesos per kill, plus a chance at Ilbi Throwing-Stars.
Can you sell NX items for mesos?
Yes. Cash Shop outfits and Selective 5-slot Coupons trade on the Free Market, at about 15 mesos per NX on Oct 20. Don't buy mesos from sellers: Nexon bans for real-money trading.
